"Back already? My instruments say the Abyss has not given you what we need yet. Find one of the shrouded things out there and put it down. The sniffer will do the rest."

"There you are. The sniffer we installed on your ships lit up like a nova the moment you engaged it. With the data obtained through quantum entanglement communication directly during the encounter, we've been able to create this."

"Sol is where it belongs now. Do enjoy it, $playerName. I certainly intend to."

id: # Step 12: the player has already fought the Shroud.

text: "Here's the thing: we won't. We won't access it from there. What we've built is something way, way more intricate. We installed... a sniffer on your ships. It secretly relayed to us every encounter you've had with what we call the Shroud. With the data obtained through quantum entanglement communication directly during those encounters, we've been able to create this."

"We're missing something. We need to tune into a sort of... frequency. We don't yet have everything we need for the technology our R&D team is proposing. We estimate that we might find something in abyssal hyperspace. From what we know, there MUST be something there that allowed Sol to start transmitting. Please, go out into the Abyss and find something that can help us."

The lattice tightens. "Something shrouded. You will know it when it tries to kill you. Destroy one and come back."

"Take this. This will allow you to transport Sol into a more suitable location. You have to be directly on top of these coordinates to not destabilize the fabric of reality."

Coordinates scroll across the link, far beyond the northern edge of every chart you own. The device itself is already sitting in your cargo hold. Nobody saw it arrive.
The link closes.

"Pity. Sol will wait. It has practice."

The link closes.

id: # Skipping the quest: confirmation and spawn.

text: Are you sure? This will place the Sol system in the Persean Sector right now, skipping the rest of the quest.

The lattice flares, and for a moment every display on the bridge shows the same thing: a yellow star, nine worlds, and a set of coordinates inside the Persean Sector.

"There. Consider the paperwork skipped."
"As you wish."
